Guardiola reveals reason for rejecting Italy job and defends Ancelotti while praising Messi and Ronaldo

2026-11-25

Guardiola revealed that he turned down the Italy national team job last July due to his need for a break after 18 years of coaching, feeling embarrassed to decline a team of Italy's stature.

AS Roma hold Paris Saint-Germain to a thrilling draw

2026-11-26

Liverpool thrash Club Brugge 3-0 in UEFA Champions League

2026-11-26

Flick: Happy with what the players delivered, and this was not easy for them

2026-11-25

Barcelona thrash Sabah in UEFA Champions League

2026-11-25

Enrique: It was the toughest match of the season.. Roma deserved to win

Luis Enrique praised AS Roma's performance in the 2-2 draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League, acknowledging the difficulty of the match and the challenge posed by the Italian team.

Bisseck: Inter capable of winning many matches if we maintain our defensive focus

Inter beat VfB Stuttgart 2-0 in the UEFA Champions League, and defender Yann Bisseck emphasized the importance of maintaining focus and mental presence to continue achieving positive results.

Kivu: Inter were good in everything against VfB Stuttgart, and the important thing is we stayed as one team

Christian Kivu, coach of Inter, expressed his satisfaction with his team's mentality, organization, and discipline in the 2-0 victory over VfB Stuttgart in the UEFA Champions League, emphasizing the importance of group cohesion.

Hermoso: We played against Paris without fear and Gasperini gave Roma a new identity

Spanish defender Mario Hermoso expressed his happiness with the 2-2 draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League, praising Roma's character and the style of coach Gian Piero Gasperini.

Gasperini: Happy and proud of AS Roma's performance against Paris.. Hermoso is an exceptional player

Gasperini expressed his pride in AS Roma's performance in the 2-2 draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League, praising their fighting spirit and technical and tactical development.

João Neves: Roma are one of the best teams we have faced

João Neves praised the individual and collective level of AS Roma after the 2-2 draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the UEFA Champions League.

Simeone: I believe in Alvarez's abilities, we delivered a serious and strong performance

Simeone praised Atlético's performance in their victory over Viking in the UEFA Champions League, reaffirmed his support for Julián Alvarez, and spoke about Alejandro Grimaldo and Lo Normand.

Nuno Mendes: AS Roma caused us a lot of problems and we couldn't control the game's tempo

Nuno Mendes admits to Paris Saint-Germain's difficulties against AS Roma, which led to a 2-2 draw in the UEFA Champions League, and confirms his readiness to play in any position.

Bruno Fernandes shines as Lemans spoils Manchester United's comeback against Sporting

Manchester United drew 2-2 with Sporting Lisbon in the Champions League, after goalkeeper Lemans' errors cost them victory, with Bruno Fernandes shining by scoring two goals.

LOSC Lille turn the tables on FC Bayern in the UEFA Champions League

LOSC Lille beat their visitors FC Bayern 2-1 in the UEFA Champions League, having overturned a deficit in the second half.
